title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Kodra Diellit 2, Shitet Super Vilete Totalisht E Investuar!
description_sq: Tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, Shitet Super Vilete e Strukturuar si Duplex dhe Totalisht e Investuar. Organizohet ne katin e pare me sallonin e bollshem se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, me dalje ne verande, tualeti, kati i dyte i strukturuar ne nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualetin e saj te dedikuar dhe dy dhoma femijesh. Vileta eshte totalisht e investuar nga pronari duke filluar qe nga instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike te cilat jane multistrad te reja, parketin i cili eshte AC5, vetratat duplex me gaz argon te cilat mundesojne pervec izolimit akustik gjithashtu dhe nje izolim termik qe bere bashke me faktin qe apartamenti ka sistem kapot ofron temperatura sa me optimale ne apartament. Gjithashtu ne sallon eshte dhe oxhaku, me sistem ngrohje ne cdo dhome. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar ku perfshiihet salloni i ndenjes bashke me oxhakun, ambienti i gatimit, tre dhomat si dhe te dy tualetet. Orientimi eshte nga Jug- Lindja cka e ben nje apartament te ekspozuar ndaj drites se diellit ne pjesen me te mire te dites gjithashtu ka dhe pamje te lire nga qyteti dhe mali i Dajtit. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje zone e cila eshte shume e kerkuar pasi ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme per nje jetese sa me komode, me ajer te paster dhe nje zone mjaft e qete. Kompleksi aksesohet dhe nga linja e transportit publik qe te sjelle deri tek hyrja e rezidences. Apartamenti pervec faktit qe eshte shume i pershtatshem per banim eshte shume i pershtatshem edhe per investim pasi zona ka kerkesa te larta qiraje. Aktualisht eshte i dhene me qira 1600 euro.
title_en: At Residence Kodra Diellit 2, Fully Invested Super Villa for Sale!
description_en: At Residence Kodra e Diellit 2, Super Villa Structured as a Duplex and Fully Invested is for sale. It is organized on the first floor with a spacious living room together with a cooking area, with access to the veranda, a toilet, the second floor is structured in a matrimonial bedroom with its dedicated toilet and two children's rooms. The villa is completely invested by the owner, starting from the electrical and plumbing installations which are new multistrad, the parquet which is AC5, the duplex windows with argon gas which enable, in addition to acoustic insulation, also a thermal insulation which, together with the fact that the apartment has a capot system, offers the most optimal temperatures in the apartment. There is also a fireplace in the living room, with a heating system in every room. The apartment is fully furnished, including the living room with the fireplace, the kitchen, the three bedrooms and the two toilets. The orientation is from the South-East, which makes the apartment exposed to sunlight for the best part of the day, and also has a clear view of the city and Dajti mountain. The area in which the apartment is located is an area that is very sought after as it offers all the necessary services for a comfortable life, with clean air and a quite quiet area. The complex is also accessed by the public transport line that brings you to the entrance of the residence. Apart from the fact that it is very suitable for living, the apartment is also very suitable for investment, since the area has high rent requirements. It is currently rented for 1600 euros.
